## Emphemera from <mastodon.online/@tomstafford>

```{=html}
<style>
  #toots { max-width: 640px; }
  .toot { border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.75em 1em; margin-bottom: 0.75em; background: #fafafa; }
  .toot-meta { font-size: 0.85em; color: #666; margin-bottom: 0.5em; }
  .toot-meta a { color: #666; text-decoration: none; }
  .toot-meta a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  .toot-content p { margin: 0.25em 0; }
  .toot-content img.emoji { height: 1em; width: 1em; vertical-align: -0.2em; }
  .toot-media { margin-top: 0.5em; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4em; }
  .toot-media a, .toot-media video, .toot-media audio { display: block; }
  .toot-media img, .toot-media video { max-width: 100%; max-height: 320px; border-radius: 4px; background: #eee; }
  .toot-media audio { width: 100%; }
</style>

<div id="toots">Loading posts from Mastodon…</div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const server = 'https://mastodon.online';
  const acct = 'tomstafford';
  const el = document.getElementById('toots');

  function renderMedia(attachments) {
    if (!attachments || attachments.length === 0) return '';
    const parts = attachments.map(m => {
      const alt = (m.description || '').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
      if (m.type === 'image') {
        return `<a href="${m.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="${m.preview_url || m.url}" alt="${alt}" loading="lazy"></a>`;
      }
      if (m.type === 'gifv') {
        return `<video src="${m.url}" poster="${m.preview_url || ''}" autoplay muted loop playsinline></video>`;
      }
      if (m.type === 'video') {
        return `<video src="${m.url}" poster="${m.preview_url || ''}" controls preload="metadata"></video>`;
      }
      if (m.type === 'audio') {
        return `<audio src="${m.url}" controls preload="metadata"></audio>`;
      }
      return `<a href="${m.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">[attachment]</a>`;
    });
    return `<div class="toot-media">${parts.join('')}</div>`;
  }

  try {
    const u = await fetch(`${server}/api/v1/accounts/lookup?acct=${acct}`);
    if (!u.ok) throw new Error('lookup failed');
    const account = await u.json();
    const s = await fetch(`${server}/api/v1/accounts/${account.id}/statuses?limit=10&exclude_replies=true&exclude_reblogs=true`);
    if (!s.ok) throw new Error('statuses failed');
    const posts = await s.json();
    el.innerHTML = '';
    for (const p of posts) {
      const t = new Date(p.created_at).toLocaleString('en-GB', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' });
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'toot';
      div.innerHTML =
        `<div class="toot-meta"><a href="${p.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${t}</a></div>` +
        `<div class="toot-content">${p.content}</div>` +
        renderMedia(p.media_attachments);
      el.appendChild(div);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    el.textContent = 'Could not load posts from Mastodon. Visit ' + server + '/@' + acct + ' directly.';
  }
})();
</script>
```
